briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 releases intensify AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation emerges as a protocol-level defense gaining traction in automotive and multi-agent sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 2.1T parameters; xAI releases Grok-3; DeepSeek-V4 tops benchmarks. Anthropic Claude 4 delayed to Q4 amid safety reviews. Meta open-sources Llama 4 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement hits first fines. NIST updates red-teaming guidelines.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped. Google TPU v6 clusters online in Iowa. Microsoft announces $15B Stargate expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory for BCI and autonomous vehicle AI by 2028?
